title: 第316章 番外昏君之别第315章 番外权谋水平
slug: 朝廷鹰犬没挨过六扇门的刀
content_zh:
杨璎这番话说完，评论区都安静了下来。
【子夫：真的，你修这剑法真修对了。】
【子夫：要是当初我是被你斗死的，我一点怨言没有。】
子夫摸了摸自己后脖颈，直接把杨璎标记为了惹不起的对象。
这家伙权谋这方面是真的狠啊。
狠话谁都会说，但杨璎这家伙恐怖的是，夺嫡时期她真是这么干的。
换言之，杨璎不是夸夸其谈，而是复盘自己当年的峥嵘岁月。
杨璎现在变成的女，就更恐怖了。
无论哪个皇朝，要是被她跑进对方后宫，那么那位皇帝后宫一定是一阵腥风血雨。
同时杨璎很能忍，要是让她熬到太后那个位置，子夫甚至怀疑这家伙会不会直接废了幼帝，自己坐上皇位。
感觉来说，这可能性很大。
子夫甚至觉得，自己完全没有和对方斗的资格。
她还是个人，但杨璎似乎把人性给丢了。
【温国公：要是我当初是被你算计死的，我也服了。】
奉先也是感慨了这么一句，这家伙也太阴险了。
【隋世宗：不收徒。】
杨璎一点不客气，和李君器拍戏这段时间，她学了不少东西。
连带着堡宗这种称呼，都是她跟着学来的。
众人插科打诨之际，灵晶内的堡宗也成功复辟。
接下来，不出众人所料，堡宗复辟后，立马着手弄死景泰帝与于迁。

景泰帝在殿内“病逝”，看的皇帝立马高血压了。
他原本这次是好结局，结果景泰死了。
很快，堡宗着手弄死了于迁。
和武穆的手法差不多，都是莫须有。
于迁死后被抄家，家中只有景泰赐的蟒袍与宝剑。
此外家中清贫，无金银财宝。
明明应该很感人，但经过杨璎前面一说，众人心中倒是没什么波澜。
哪怕看到粉骨碎身浑不怕，要留清白在人间。
众人内心也只是想笑，比起武穆那种逆大势而行，保全天下而亡的气魄，于迁在他们看来有些咎由自取之意。
皇帝和周公都是一叹，他们和杨璎李愿这种极度明辨利益之辈不一样。
他们只惋惜人才没有在自己底下，发挥出应有的作用。
于迁的愚忠，要是在他们底下，就是君臣美谈。
错在堡宗，而非于迁。
【温国公：好死，让你非得迎回圣眷，这下好了吧。】
【霍小公子：放尊重点，再怎么说他也保全了江山社稷。】
【温国公：你爱武帝，武帝爱卫家人吗？】
【温国公：宣帝爱霍家人吗？】
奉先直接学会了杨璎的打法，往人心窝子捅就对了。
【霍小公子：你等着，我这就去废了你。】
但去病很明显不讲道理，他不打杨璎是不屑于以大欺小。

一点口角纠纷，又不是真打了他，他无所谓。
content_en:
After Yang Ying finished speaking, the comment area became quiet.
[Zihu: Really, you have practiced this swordsmanship correctly. 】
[Zifu: If I had been killed by you, I would have no complaints at all. 】
Zifu touched the back of his neck and directly marked Yang Ying as someone he couldn't afford to mess with.
This guy is really ruthless in his tactics.
Anyone can say cruel things, but what’s scary about Yang Ying is that she really did this during the period of seizing the throne.
In other words, Yang Ying is not boasting, but reviewing her own prosperous years.
The woman Yang Ying has become now is even more terrifying.
No matter which dynasty, if she ran into the other's harem, then that emperor's harem would definitely be a bloody storm.
At the same time, Yang Ying was very tolerant. If she was allowed to endure the position of Queen Mother, Zifu even doubted whether this guy would directly depose the young emperor and take the throne himself.
It feels like this is very possible.
Zifu even felt that he was completely unqualified to fight with the opponent.
She is still a human being, but Yang Ying seems to have lost her humanity.
[Wen Guogong: If I had been tricked to death by you, I would have accepted it. 】
Fengxian also said with emotion, this guy is too insidious.
[Sui Shizong: No disciples. 】
Yang Ying is not polite at all. She learned a lot during filming with Li Junqi.
Even the title "Baozong" was learned from her.
While everyone was making jokes, the Bao Sect in the Spiritual Crystal was also successfully restored.
Next, as everyone expected, after Baozong was restored, he immediately set out to kill Emperor Jingtai and Yu Qian.
Emperor Jingtai "died" of illness in the palace, and the emperor immediately developed high blood pressure.
He originally had a good ending this time, but Jingtai died.
Soon, Baozong set out to kill Yu Qian.
It's similar to Wu Mu's method, it's all unfounded.
After Yu Qian's death, his house was confiscated, and all he had in his house was the python robe and sword given by Jing Tai.
In addition, the family was poor and had no gold or silver.
It should be very touching, but after what Yang Ying said before, everyone didn't feel any excitement at all.
Even if you see your bones broken into pieces, you won't be afraid. You want to keep your innocence in this world.
Everyone just wanted to laugh in their hearts. Compared with Wu Mu's courage to go against the general trend and save the world from death, Yu Qian seemed to them to have brought it upon himself.
The emperor and Duke Zhou both sighed. They were different from people like Yang Ying and Li Yuan who were extremely discerning about interests.
They only regret that the talents under them do not play their due role.
If Yu Qian's foolish loyalty were under their command, it would be a good talk between the emperor and his ministers.
The fault lies with Baozong, not Yu Qian.
[Wen Guogong: It’s a good death, and you have to welcome back the holy family, now it’s okay. 】
[Little Master Huo: Be respectful, no matter what, he has preserved the country and the country. 】
[Wen Guogong: Do you love Emperor Wu, does Emperor Wu love the Wei family? 】
[Wen Guogong: Does Emperor Xuan love the Huo family? 】
Fengxian directly learned Yang Ying's style of playing, just stabbing people in the heart.
[Little Master Huo: Just wait, I will destroy you right now. 】
But Qu Bing was obviously unreasonable. He didn't beat Yang Ying because he didn't bother to bully the small ones.
There was a little verbal dispute, but it didn't really hit him, so he didn't care.
